scope: Current tracked text of firmware, NuttX, NuttX Apps and Renode Infrastructure compared to the recorded Pybricks baseline; firmware also compared to fetched current Pybricks master. Reachable local firmware history and fetched public branch tips examined. Additional explicit source-origin references reviewed.
snapshot_note: Firmware scans include the two newly staged audit tools in addition to the baseline revision. Reports freeze their individual input hashes; report/docs added afterward are not self-included. No implementation changes occurred during this review.
limitations: No mathematical proof that paraphrased or short copied code cannot exist. Token thresholds and common-seed filtering can miss such code.
No claim that a Git submodule pin proves an author never read a different revision, a web page, or training data.

Reference submodules are Git pointers, not recursively downloaded source; our NuttX and Apps trees were scanned separately. Existing independent MicroPython/Zephyr/build inventories remain applicable.
Reachable local refs only; no claim to erase or audit server caches, PR refs, releases elsewhere, unavailable dependencies or every third-party authorship chain.
This is a source-origin review, not a legal opinion. Similarity alone does not establish infringement.

method.caveat: Lexical candidate discovery only. C-style comments are omitted; comments in other languages remain tokens. Submodules and binary assets require separate review. No detection of all paraphrases or proof of absence.

github_distribution_check.scope: Current API-listed releases and artifacts in CrispStrobe/brickwright-spike-prime-fw; no claim about previously downloaded or expired material.

findings.summary: Inherited host Madgwick filter explicitly mirrors a reference C implementation; firmware is a direct port. Optimised temporary-variable layout and gradient expression sequence closely match the GPL reference. The inherited MIT declaration alone does not establish an applicable grant for that section. Similarity is not a legal finding or proof of a particular copying event.

evidence.link_map: Reviewed userspace map selects drivebase_imu.c object and retains its db_imu_integrate section.

findings.required_action: Remove or establish a compatible grant for inherited Madgwick bodies in published historical revisions; rebuild the changed configured firmware and retain updated licence evidence.
findings.current_tree_action: Both inherited gradient-descent bodies replaced with credited MIT Fusion gravity-vector feedback adapters. Current implementation and tests recorded in policy/orientation-filter.json. Historical copies and old recorded images remain uncleared.

resolution_evidence.scope: Current source and rebuilt configured simulation firmware only. Older bodies remain in Git history and are a separate open finding.
resolution_evidence.tests: C synthetic orientation suite passed; .NET 10 core suite passed 86/86; actual ARM protected build passed; build inputs and byte-identical userspace linker replay updated.

findings.summary: Current tree and recorded simulation build exclude TI; reachable older firmware commits still distribute the TI payload and accompanying restrictive licence. This fails the exclusively permissive repository-history policy, not automatically the TI licence itself.
findings.required_action: Prepare and review history filtering across all public branches; publishing changed ancestry requires a coordinated force-push. Server PR/cache refs and existing clones need separate handling.

resolution_evidence.scope: Reachability from the advertised firmware branches/tags only. Retired revisions remain uncleared private evidence; unavailable server-side objects and other clones are outside scope.

findings.summary: 17 older public feature-branch tips lack the current Pybricks/LEGO grant copies. Current main attribution corrections do not make exports of those branch tips complete.
findings.required_action: Repair or retire older public snapshots as part of coordinated history/ref cleanup. Review historical notices, not only current main.

resolution_evidence.scope: Reachability from the advertised firmware branches/tags only. Retired revisions remain uncleared private evidence; unavailable server-side objects and other clones are outside scope.

findings.summary: External NuttX arch/arm/src/phy62xx/types.h shares a 206-token exact byte-packing macro block with the TI BSD-3-Clause hal_defs.h vendored in the Pybricks reference. NuttX labels its file Apache-2.0. This may be common HAL ancestry; origin/notice history needs separate clarification before importing or selecting that PHY62xx input. It is absent from the STM32 simulation input manifest.
findings.required_action: Keep excluded from this build; review original PHYplus/TI provenance if it becomes a required dependency.

findings.evidence: Earlier reachable commits contain the inherited host filter and firmware gradient-descent bodies. Replacing current files does not establish their historical grant.
findings.required_action: Remove those revisions from published refs or establish a compatible grant; preserve private archival evidence without republishing uncleared material.

resolution_evidence.scope: Reachability from the advertised firmware branches/tags only. Retired revisions remain uncleared private evidence; unavailable server-side objects and other clones are outside scope.
